name: Press Gate
design_intent:
PRESS GATE — THE SCRAPWORKS tier-2 single-CRUSHER stage (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 14). The flagship three-island / one-void shape with ONE horizontal steel CRUSHER (anvil press) gating the mid-lane on the centre island B — the circuit's introduction to the crushing-press family with a single, readable machine. The heads instakill only when they SQUEEZE (kill(&ring_out); no shove/hitstun). Kill identity = time the gate, knock rivals into the closing heads or off into the void. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

HAZARD DOCTRINE (crusher, horizontal): (1) LETHAL only when a body is truly squeezed in the closing band; contact routes to kill(&ring_out), never sets last_attacker (untagged kill = uncredited self-fall; a knocker within 6.0s is credited). (2) TELEGRAPHY — a long OPEN DWELL (heads parked at B's edges = the clear beat), then a windup SHUDDER + hazard-red FLASH on the closing faces for telegraph_lead 0.55s BEFORE a fast ~0.34s close (period 2.6s). (3) FAIRNESS — the lethal band SHIFTS and never covers all of B at once: OPEN, the heads sit at B's edges leaving the CENTRE clear; CLOSED, they meet at centre leaving B's LEFT and RIGHT edges clear; a standing refuge on B ALWAYS exists, and islands A/C are permanent refuges. Boosting UP above the head band (y945..1115) also clears a slam.

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 (the GATE, center 2030) / C x3160..4060 top1080, 680px void gaps. ONE horizontal CRUSHER: center (2030,1030), head_len 200, head_w 170, open_gap 560, closed_gap 30, period_s 2.6, phase 0.0, close_time 0.34, closed_time 0.22, retract_time 0.5, telegraph_lead 0.55. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878. VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Overcast grey open_sky = a press yard.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; ~395px trampoline drift / ~527 max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CROSS the GATE on B: shuffle with the crusher's rhythm (centre-safe when open, edges-safe when closed) or boost up above the head band; a mistimed stand in the closing band = instant off-screen kill. The crusher stays over B and always leaves a refuge, so it never makes a required gap uncrossable. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- RECOVER: island bottoms (1192-1208) to the bottom blast line (1878) = 670-686px of open sky (>= 650) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back. Verb: FLY.
- Zero-boost from any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap (falls into the void): flight is REQUIRED; the gate times the mid-lane but never creates a bounce path across a gap. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SIGNATURE: the mid-lane gate — one horizontal press you must time to cross the centre island (distinct from first_hammer's rotor and crusher_row's twin vertical stamps).
